negative_or_deferred.no_hash_reason: The publisher denied the automated PDF request; no access-control bypass was attempted.

negative_or_deferred.no_hash_reason: This is a missing field, not an unavailable document.
negative_or_deferred.contingency: Keep displacement null/deferred. Only an attributable decision record may close the field; do not infer it from X24, RAL, QU9, PBC 10X, E13/S(HSS)/c, or 02B.

rights_boundary: ODS organisation fields are classified reuse-confirmed under the stated OGL coverage. NICE and NHS document fields remain citation-only. No raw ODS or document payloads are committed, and identifiers are not promoted into empirical model inputs.
